dataset.validation_source: stratified holdout from pinned mirror train split only
dataset.test_policy: select best epoch on validation only; score the complete pinned mirror test split once after training

method.name: ShareLoRA
method.target_layers: q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj, fc1, fc2 in each of 12 CLIP vision transformer blocks
method.sharing: One shared A object per target projection family (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj, fc1, fc2); independent B per target layer. This is the validated team interpretation of image ShareLoRA sharing.

training.scheduler: linear warmup then constant LR (team interpretation of Table 9 LR decay=0)

paper_settings: accuracy metric and a photo of a {class} prompt
team_choices: Use the mirror train/test split; equivalence to the paper original split is unverified
linear warmup then constant LR because Table 9 LR decay is 0
fixed stratified 10% validation subset from train using seed 2026
ShareLoRA: projection-family shared A objects and per-layer B objects; strict E2LoRA claim not made
provenance.source_note: The ordered 43 class names are taken verbatim from the pinned ClassLabel feature; runtime verifies label order and split counts.
